messages.subject: Project Northwind — board pack and completion plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley, Priya,

Ahead of the board meeting on 12 June, I attach the draft board minutes approving the restructuring and authorising execution, together with the completion checklist / CP tracker and the completion funds flow. The board pack records the directors' duties analysis (including the creditor-interest point) — please review section 3 of the minutes.

We are targeting an effective date of 26 June. Net new liquidity to the Company on completion is c.£3.12m after fees. Please come back with any comments by close tomorrow.

James
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
